title: Crestline Credit Card Payment Allocation Terms
content:
On every Crestline Credit Card product a payment is divided in the same way: the minimum payment goes to the balance with the **lowest** APR first, and any amount above the minimum goes to the balance with the **highest** APR first. During the last 2 billing cycles before a deferred-interest plan expires, the amount above the minimum goes to that plan's balance first. A merchandise credit reduces the balance of the original ticket it refunds.

## Terms table (identical on all six products)

| Term | Setting |
|---|---|
| Minimum payment | lowest APR balance first |
| Amount above the minimum | highest APR balance first |
| Promotional window before a deferred-interest plan expires | 2 billing cycles |
| Merchandise credit | reduces the balance of the original ticket |

The six products are the Crestline Auto Care Card Starter, Crestline Auto Care Card, Crestline Auto Care Card Preferred, Crestline Auto Care Mastercard, Crestline Auto Care Mastercard Preferred and Crestline Auto Care World Mastercard.

## Illustration on hypothetical balances

An account carries a standard purchase balance at the purchase APR and an equal-payment plan balance at that plan's reduced APR. A payment of 300 USD against a 60 USD minimum: the 60 USD goes first to the equal-payment balance, the lower APR, and the remaining 240 USD goes first to the standard balance, the higher APR. If the account also carries a deferred-interest plan that is within its last 2 billing cycles before expiring, the 240 USD goes first to that plan's balance instead.
